description: a ball of radius 2 revolved about z — one sphere face closed on its two degenerate edges, its seam the meridian in the profile plane — less a block whose corner (0.6, −0.7, 0.3) is inside it, the block turned 12° about (1, 1, 1) through the origin so none of its three planes is a parallel's or a meridian's: three small circles, each an exact circle edge over a pcurve fitted on the sphere's own projection (ADR-0021), two of them across the seam, all clear of both poles. The first boolean a whole sphere face is an operand of; the ball keeps its seam and both poles, and the notch is a loop of three arcs in the one face
